messages:
maria: Heads-up 10m after the routing weight change I see endpoint /v1/chat p95 +95ms but p99 -130ms on the endpoint dashboard. dashboard only shows merged quantiles so this looks like a mixed-route effect. anyone else seeing it?

jin: yep saw the same. quick per-route check shows main p95 180ms p99 890ms (cnt 28k) fallback p95 340ms p99 420ms (cnt 3.6k). merged tdigest p95 ends up ~230ms.

aya: classic tdigest merge artifact when two clusters exist. merged approx summaries can overshoot when centroids compress across modes.

janet (console): UX note: users assume endpoint p95 is single-distribution. can we add a small "routes:N" badge on the sparkline and expand hover to show per-route p50/p95/p99 + counts? also add an "approx" pill when tdigest is used.

maria: also proposal: if fallback_fraction > 5% or a diptest indicates bimodality, show a yellow banner: "Mixed routing detected (Y% fallback). See per-route view."

jin: operational ask: can telemetry emit a bimodal_flag and preserve X-Route-Used header at ingestion? right now some proxies drop it and that breaks attribution.

telemetry-bot: Quick job: per-route quantiles (/v1/chat) 30m -> main p95 178ms p99 892ms cnt 28,320; fallback p95 338ms p99 418ms cnt 3,610; diptest=0.36 fallback_fraction=11%.

aya: Recommend three items: (1) console badge + hover + approx pill, (2) bimodal_flag emission + prefer_exact_quantiles toggle for exact on-demand queries, (3) rollout runbook update: "If fallback_fraction>3% or bimodal_flag=true, compare per-route p50/p95 before approving."

janet (console): I'll spec the badge, hover layout, and the auto-banner behavior. will include mockups showing counts inline next to percentiles.

maria: jin, can you confirm gateway preserves X-Route-Used for mobile clients? if not, SRE needs to fix header rewrites.

jin: will trace and post results.

aya: longer term: prototype fixed-bucket histograms per-endpoint as a hybrid aggregator to make quantiles stable for multimodal loads without fetching raw samples.

janet (console): for short term I'll push the "approx" pill + tooltip change this week to reduce misreads.

maria: action items: jin->verify header preservation; janet->spec and small EOD UX change; aya->prototype histogram idea; i'll update the rollout runbook. tagging @sre for visibility. :thumbsup:
